requiredAttribution.text: Effect collection compiled for the Initiative Tracker project.

conditions.name: Ancestral Protector(s)
conditions.description: Barbarian feature. On your hit, spirits mark the target until the end of your next turn. Other creatures have disadvantage attacking anyone but you; if the marked target attacks anyone but you, it has disadvantage.

conditions.name: Armor of Agathys
conditions.description: Gain temporary HP. Any creature that hits you with a melee attack takes cold damage equal to the temporary HP you started with. Ends when that temporary HP is depleted.

conditions.name: Bear's Endurance
conditions.description: Advantage on Constitution checks and gain 2d6 temporary HP. Concentration, up to 1 hour.

conditions.name: Bull's Strength
conditions.description: Advantage on Strength checks to push, pull, lift, or break. Carrying capacity is doubled. Concentration, up to 1 hour.

conditions.name: Cat's Grace
conditions.description: Advantage on Dexterity checks and no damage from falls of 20 feet or less when not incapacitated. Concentration, up to 1 hour.

conditions.name: Eagle's Splendor
conditions.description: Advantage on Charisma checks. Concentration, up to 1 hour.

conditions.name: Fox's Cunning
conditions.description: Advantage on Intelligence checks. Concentration, up to 1 hour.

conditions.name: Owl's Wisdom
conditions.description: Advantage on Wisdom checks. Concentration, up to 1 hour.

conditions.name: Blessed
conditions.description: Add 1d4 to attack rolls and saving throws. Concentration, up to 1 minute.

conditions.name: Blink
conditions.description: At the end of each of your turns, roll a d20; on 11 or higher you vanish to the Ethereal Plane until the start of your next turn or until the spell ends.

conditions.name: Blur
conditions.description: Attack rolls against you have disadvantage because your body is blurred and indistinct. Concentration, up to 1 minute.

conditions.name: Causing Fear
conditions.description: Each creature in a 30-foot cone makes a Wisdom save or becomes Frightened, drops what it is holding, and uses its reaction to move away from you. Concentration, up to 1 minute.

conditions.name: Divine Favor
conditions.description: Weapon attacks deal an extra 1d4 radiant damage on a hit. Concentration, up to 1 minute.

conditions.name: Hasted
conditions.description: Speed is doubled, AC increases by 2, Dexterity saves have advantage, and the target gains an extra action limited to Attack, Dash, Disengage, Hide, or Use an Object. When the effect ends, the target is lethargic and cannot move or take actions until after its next turn. Concentration, up to 1 minute.

conditions.name: Insightful Fighting
conditions.description: A successful contested check grants the feature's benefits against the target, including qualifying for Sneak Attack without advantage. Ends after the next short or long rest or when used on a different target.

conditions.name: Inspired
conditions.description: The creature holds one Bardic Inspiration die and may spend it on an ability check, attack roll, or saving throw. Ends when the die is spent or after 10 minutes.

conditions.name: Mage Armor
conditions.description: AC becomes 13 plus the creature's Dexterity modifier while it is not wearing armor.

conditions.name: Mirror Image
conditions.description: Creates three illusory duplicates. Attackers randomly determine whether they hit the creature or a duplicate; a hit destroys a duplicate. Ends when all duplicates are destroyed or after 1 minute.

conditions.name: Raging
conditions.description: Advantage on Strength checks and saves, bonus melee damage, and resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage. The creature cannot cast or concentrate on spells. May end early when its maintenance conditions are not met.

conditions.name: Sanctuary
conditions.description: A creature targeting the protected creature with an attack or harmful spell must first make a Wisdom save or choose a new target. Ends when the protected creature attacks or casts a spell that affects an enemy.

conditions.name: Shell Defense
conditions.description: The creature withdraws into its shell, gaining 4 AC and advantage on Strength and Constitution saves, while suffering disadvantage on Dexterity saves. It becomes prone, cannot move, and can only use its action to end this state.

conditions.name: Shield of Faith
conditions.description: The target gains a 2-point bonus to AC. Concentration, up to 10 minutes.

conditions.name: Spirit Guardians
conditions.description: Spirits occupy a 15-foot radius around the creature. Enemies treat the area as difficult terrain and make Wisdom saves when entering or starting their turns there, taking radiant or necrotic damage. Concentration, up to 10 minutes.

conditions.name: Symbiotic Entity
conditions.description: The creature gains temporary HP and deals extra necrotic damage with qualifying attacks. Ends when the temporary HP is gone, when ended manually, or after 10 minutes.

conditions.name: Truesight
conditions.description: Within the stated range, see in normal and magical darkness, see invisible creatures and objects, detect visual illusions, and see into the Ethereal Plane. Duration depends on the granting source.

conditions.name: Warding Bond
conditions.description: The target gains 1 AC, a 1-point bonus to saving throws, and resistance to all damage; the bonded creature takes the same damage. Ends if dispelled or if the pair remain more than 60 feet apart for at least 1 minute.

conditions.name: Baned
conditions.description: Subtract 1d4 from attack rolls and saving throws. Concentration, up to 1 minute.

conditions.name: Compelled Duel
conditions.description: The target cannot willingly move more than 30 feet from the caster and has disadvantage on attacks against anyone else. Concentration, up to 1 minute.

conditions.name: Hexed
conditions.description: The target takes an extra 1d6 necrotic damage when hit by the hexer's attacks and has disadvantage on checks using one chosen ability. Concentration, up to 1 hour or longer when cast at higher levels.

conditions.name: Hexblade Cursed
conditions.description: The target takes extra damage equal to the curser's proficiency bonus and is critically hit on a roll of 19 or 20. Ends when the target dies or the curse is redirected.

conditions.name: Highlighted
conditions.description: The target is outlined in light, cannot benefit from invisibility, and attacks against it have advantage. Concentration, up to 1 minute.

conditions.name: Marked
conditions.description: The target takes an extra 1d6 damage from the marking creature's weapon attacks, and the marking creature has advantage on checks to find it. Concentration, up to 1 hour.

conditions.name: Prey
conditions.description: Once per turn, the target takes an extra 1d6 damage when hit by the hunter. Ends when reduced to 0 HP, redirected, or after 1 minute.

conditions.name: Entangled
conditions.description: Speed is halved while in the affected area. On a failed Strength save when applied, the target becomes Restrained instead. Ends on leaving the area or after 1 minute.

conditions.name: Summoned
conditions.description: Indicates that a summoned creature or spell effect is under the caster's control.

conditions.name: Concentration
conditions.description: A creature can sustain only one concentration effect at a time. Taking damage requires a Constitution save with DC 10 or half the damage taken, whichever is higher. Concentration ends when the caster is incapacitated, dies, starts another concentration effect, or fails the save.

conditions.name: Invisible
conditions.description: Impossible to see without special senses and treated as heavily obscured for hiding. Attacks against the creature have disadvantage and its attacks have advantage.

conditions.name: Shifted
conditions.description: Shifted into an alternative form. Refer to the form's rules for its specific effects.

conditions.name: Stabilized
conditions.description: A dying creature that is stabilized stops making death saves and remains unconscious at 0 HP until it regains at least 1 HP.

conditions.name: Flying
conditions.description: The creature has a flying speed for the stated duration. It may fall if flight ends while airborne without another means of staying aloft.

conditions.name: Advantage
conditions.description: Roll two d20s and use the higher result. Multiple sources do not stack. Applies to ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws, not damage rolls.

conditions.name: Unconscious
conditions.description: Incapacitated and unaware of surroundings; drops held items and falls prone; automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saves; attacks against it have advantage; hits from within 5 feet are critical hits.

conditions.name: Stunned
conditions.description: Incapacitated, unable to move, and able to speak only falteringly. Automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saves, and attacks against it have advantage.

conditions.name: Restrained
conditions.description: Speed becomes 0; attacks against the creature have advantage; its own attacks have disadvantage; and it has disadvantage on Dexterity saves.

conditions.name: Blinded
conditions.description: Cannot see and automatically fails checks requiring sight. Attacks against the creature have advantage and its attacks have disadvantage.

conditions.name: Charmed
conditions.description: Cannot attack or harm the charmer. The charmer has advantage on social ability checks against the creature.

conditions.name: Deafened
conditions.description: Cannot hear and automatically fails checks requiring hearing.

conditions.name: Exhausted
conditions.description: A stacking condition with cumulative levels: disadvantage on ability checks; speed halved; disadvantage on attacks and saves; HP maximum halved; speed 0; then death at level 6. A qualifying long rest reduces exhaustion by one level.

conditions.name: Incapacitated
conditions.description: Cannot take actions or reactions.

conditions.name: Paralyzed
conditions.description: Incapacitated, unable to move or speak, and automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saves. Attacks against it have advantage and hits from within 5 feet are critical hits.

conditions.name: Petrified
conditions.description: Transformed into solid inanimate substance; incapacitated, unable to move or speak, and unaware. Attacks have advantage, Strength and Dexterity saves automatically fail, damage is resisted, and poison and disease are suspended.

conditions.name: Poisoned
conditions.description: Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

conditions.name: Prone
conditions.description: Can only crawl until standing and has disadvantage on attacks. Attacks from within 5 feet have advantage; attacks from farther away have disadvantage. Standing costs half the creature's movement.

conditions.name: Grappled
conditions.description: Speed becomes 0 and cannot benefit from speed bonuses. Ends when the creature escapes, leaves the grappler's reach, or the grappler becomes incapacitated.

conditions.name: Bleeding
conditions.description: Takes ongoing damage determined by the source at the start of each turn. Ends on a successful save.

conditions.name: Burning
conditions.description: Takes ongoing fire damage determined by the source at the start of each turn. Ends on a successful save or after moving out of the fire.

conditions.name: Confused
conditions.description: At the start of each turn, roll a d10 to determine whether the creature wanders, does nothing or attacks itself, attacks the nearest creature, or acts normally. Ends according to the source's Wisdom-save terms.

conditions.name: Frightened
conditions.description: Disadvantage on ability checks and attacks while the source of fear is visible, and cannot willingly move closer to that source.

conditions.name: Possessed
conditions.description: The body is controlled by another consciousness while the original mind is suppressed and unable to act. Ends according to the possessing effect's terms.

conditions.name: Disadvantage
conditions.description: Roll two d20s and use the lower result. Multiple sources do not stack. Applies to ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws, not damage rolls.
